BrochureContent.Content:
O'Donnellan & Joyce are delighted to offer for sale 40 College Road, a substantial five-bedroom mid-terrace residence occupying an excellent position on one of Galway City's most established and sought-after residential areas.

Extending to approximately 201 sq.m., the property offers generous accommodation, excellent proportions with a versatile layout that would lend itself to a variety of uses and refurbishment possibilities.

The accommodation currently comprises a living room, kitchen/dining room and a double bedroom at ground level, with a further bedroom and bathroom at an intermediate level and three bedrooms on the first floor. 

The property also benefits from a generous entrance/hallway arrangement and excellent overall proportions. The existing layout provides a superb blank canvas for those wishing to modernise and create a comfortable home in a highly convenient city location.

The principal attraction of No. 40 College Road is undoubtedly its superb location. Situated within easy walking distance of Galway City Centre, the property is perfectly positioned to enjoy all that the city has to offer, including Eyre Square, the Latin Quarter and an extensive choice of shops, cafés, bars and restaurants.

There are also a host of recreational and scenic amenities close by, including Lough Atalia, the Corrib Walkway, Spanish Arch and Galway Cathedral, while the property is conveniently located opposite the Dexcom Galway Sportsgrounds.

For those commuting or working in the city, the location is particularly attractive, with Galway's main bus and train stations within easy walking distance. University of Galway, University Hospital Galway and ATU Galway are all readily accessible, while excellent road and public transport connections provide convenient access to surrounding employment centres including Liosban and Mervue.

The combination of five bedrooms, approximately 119 sq.m. of accommodation and an exceptional city-centre location makes No. 40 College Road an appealing proposition for owner-occupiers, investors or purchasers seeking a property with strong long-term potential.

Properties on College Road are highly sought after and rarely come to the market. No. 40 offers an excellent opportunity to acquire a substantial residence in a prime Galway City location and create a home tailored to your own requirements.

Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the location, proportions, and potential this property has to offer.
